description: This file defines the AppDatabase class using Room, an ORM library for Android, providing the database schema, DAO access methods, and singleton instance management.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class extending RoomDatabase, providing DAOs for profile, connection, and transfer history, and a singleton instance accessor.

methods.name: profileDao
methods.description: Abstract method to access ProfileDao for profile data operations.

methods.name: connectionDao
methods.description: Abstract method to access ConnectionDao for connection data operations.

methods.name: transferHistoryDao
methods.description: Abstract method to access TransferHistoryDao for transfer history data operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides the singleton AppDatabase instance, creating it with Room.databaseBuilder or falling back to an in-memory database on failure.
